encoding.bits: fixed-width lowercase 0x strings for all raw payloads; metadata/counts/normalized I32 coordinates are JSON integers
encoding.packing: Element0 occupies lowest width bits; U64/F64 low U32 word comes first; tail fill is explicit and not a logical element.
encoding.views: Signed element strides and offsets into named source storage. Logical order is row-major. Output is a private dense offset-zero snapshot.

legacy: F32/I32 and accepted Assign guards preserve old paths; only the finite exact all-order domain is used as their numerical oracle. New C3 special policy never redefines them.
linux: Actual results UNKNOWN; public CUDA F64 source-declined. No recorded backend pass flags.
main_shape_choice: Arithmetic/error rank1 destination [4]; rank>=2 [2,4,1...]. Assign rank1 [5], rank>=2 [3,5,1...] gives odd live element counts for explicit tails. ND broadcast-index rows use [4,4,1...] and K=2 diagonal tuples. Axis is0 for rank1, otherwise1. Explicit public gradient metadata is unchanged. Repeated ordinary targets are [2,2,0]; ND non-Add targets [2,0,1]. Assign duplicate values are bit-identical, requiring no new winner rule.

model_provenance.extraction: Exact prefix before def main(); no external model imports or expected-arithmetic paths.

scope: Reference candidate only; no production, registration, compiler or runtime acceptance.

C1.reason: Preserve existing Scatter and packed Assign control meanings; new format/op/reserved fields get exact validation.
C1.timing: Only after checkpoint54 closure and separate production-start. No kernel ID allocated here.

C2.CAS: Compiler feasibility comparison only; not selected production baseline.
C2.order: For each destination logical element, initialize from its base bits and visit matching contributions in ascending logical update order.
C2.packed: One U32 owner computes every live8/16bit field and emits one whole-word store. Unused tail fields and untouched fields preserve original bits.
C2.performance: Correctness baseline only; measure before optimization and preserve this numerical contract.
C2.selected: exclusive physical word owner with per-field ordered folds
C2.wide: One owner computes both U32 words of each64bit payload. No split atomic arithmetic.

Add_Mul.BF16: exact stored BF16 operands widen to F32; one binary32 RNE operation with gradual underflow; one BF16 RNE conversion after EVERY update
Add_Mul.F16: exact stored F16 operands widen to F32; one binary32 RNE operation with gradual underflow; one F16 RNE conversion after EVERY update
Add_Mul.F64: one binary64 RNE operation per update, gradual underflow
Add_Mul.Flex32: one binary32 RNE operation per update, gradual underflow; no Tensor Core operand rounding
Add_Mul.NaN: Touched Add/Mul NaN results become canonical positive quiet NaN in destination dtype. Untouched base bits stay exact.
Add_Mul.infinity: IEEE class/sign rules; invalid infinity cancellation or zero times infinity yields canonical quiet NaN.
Add_Mul.zero: IEEE RNE Add: both negative zeros yield negative zero, exact cancellation yields positive zero. Mul uses sign XOR, including zero.

Min_Max.NaN: If exactly one operand is NaN, select the numeric operand unchanged. If both are NaN, keep base sign/payload and set its quiet bit.
Min_Max.comparison: Exact dtype-aware comparison of raw encodings, including true F64; no narrowing through F32 or signed I64 for U64.
Min_Max.finite_ties: Keep base bits for equal nonzero finite values.
Min_Max.implementation_direction: Explicit classification and bit selection; do not infer policy solely from compiler minf/maxf attributes.
Min_Max.zeros: Min(-0,+0)=-0; Max(-0,+0)=+0, independent of input order.

C3.empty_or_no_match: Return original base bits unchanged, including signed zero, signaling NaN and payload.
C3.error_scope: Keep current checked resident index normalization, recoverable bounds status and deferred wrapper; no asynchronous protocol redesign.
C3.evidence_limits: This selects a project contract. Compiler IR, independent references and later selected Linux/Native runs must still verify it. No tolerance widening or vendor-order guarantee.
C3.integers: Add/Mul wrap modulo2^width after every update. Min/Max compare exact declared signedness and full width.
C3.preserve_old: Existing F32/I32 dispatch, atomic or ordered paths, numerical policies and error behavior remain byte-preserved.
C3.selected: Explicit Native serial extension for new formats; actual Linux differences stay visible.
